title: P38: GroupInfo encryption uses suite 1 HPKE
description: protocol-06 §5.6 ties cipher_suite only to the signatures and never says which suite's HPKE encrypts encrypted_groupinfo_and_tree. Readings: (a) the request's cipher_suite; (b) the room's MLS suite; (c) fixed. Chosen: suite 1 (the only suite mimid supports, decision mimid-1wgh.23), which (a)/(b)/(c) coincide on today. wg item filed.
